title: NATS request/reply studio.runs.create (pipelines → studio)
description: Core NATS request/reply on subject `studio.runs.create` (queue group `studio`), bare JSON like auth.validate.*. Creates a batch-lane run for one step of one row, idempotent on idempotency_key: asking again returns the same run (`created: false`) with its current status, so a caller that lost the reply, or restarted, just asks again. Studio takes the owner, session, lane and graph from the batch record (its snapshot), never from the request: owner_id, session_id and workflow_id must match the batch or the reply is `not_found`. The inputs are resolved and checked like RunRequest.inputs against the snapshot graph. No live host: the run is created `failed` (as in Create); a stopped batch: created `cancelled`; a paused batch: created `queued` and held. A timeout (5 s) or `internal` is retried by the caller with backoff under the same key. From API 1.14 the same request makes the ask run of a judge, write or decide node: workflow_id = the node's resolved ask workflow (one of snapshot.pipeline.workflows), inputs = `ask.*` values only (the template filled by pipelines, `ask.media` as `{take: {take_id}}` rows of image or video takes the owner has; a family ask also `model.precision` = the judged step's), idempotency key node = the judge/write/decide node id, loop = visit from 0, branch 0 (1 for the re-ask). From API 1.15: an Agent turn is one such ask run (key branch `t<turn>`, `t<turn>r` for its re-ask), the director's chat turns use row 0; a node whose model is a local server asks for workflow `server-ask` (a built-in text workflow: inputs `ask.*` incl. `ask.provider`, `ask.model`, `ask.tools`), which the dispatcher releases on the provider's host to pipelines_service's server executor (contracts/README.md, Model sources). From API 1.43: `purpose: name` (no batch_id or row) makes a session's hidden naming run (contracts/README.md, Sessions: titles and naming): workflow `llm-ask`, inputs `ask.system`, `ask.prompt`, `ask.schema`, `ask.max_tokens` only, idempotency key `name:<session_id>`; owner and session must match the session row (else `not_found`). It runs in the batch lane, is left out of the session's runs, events and the gallery, and finishes with evt.studio.run_finished (batch_id null).

workflow_id.description: which workflow of the batch's snapshot

row.description: the row; from API 1.15 0 = the director's chat thread (its turns' ask runs)

status.description: the run's status now; a terminal one means the result is already here (resume the thread with it)

created.description: false when the key already had a run

take_ids.description: the run's takes so far (all of them once succeeded)

answer.description: from API 1.14: a text workflow's run already terminal: its answer (resume the thread with it)

error.description: user-readable, e.g. `echo.steps: must be between 1 and 200`

code.description: invalid: the inputs fail the snapshot's node schemas (final: the row fails with `error`); not_found: no such batch for this owner and session, or a workflow not in its snapshot (final); internal: retry
